ayahs.1: Read—in the name of your Rabb who created—
ayahs.2: Created humanity from a clinging clot—
ayahs.3: Read! And your Rabb is the Rahman—mercy that encompasses all creation in this life—
ayahs.5: Taught humanity what they did not know—knowledge itself as a divine gift, not a self-made achievement.
ayahs.7: Whenever they see themselves as self-sufficient—wealth and status breeding arrogance that blocks the soul.
ayahs.8: Surely to your Rabb is the return.
ayahs.9: Have you seen the one who forbids—
ayahs.10: A servant when he performs salah—the formal prayer?
ayahs.11: What if he were upon guidance—
ayahs.12: Or enjoining taqwa—living with Allah-consciousness, as though Allah sees you?
ayahs.13: What if the forbidder persists in denial and turns away?
ayahs.14: Does he not know that Allah sees?
ayahs.15: No indeed! If he does not stop, We will seize him by the forelock—
ayahs.16: A lying, sinful forelock—the mark of stubborn arrogance dragged into the open—
ayahs.18: We will call the guardians of Hell—
ayahs.19: Do not obey him, O Prophet; rather prostrate and draw near to Allah.
